## Notes

- **`EPISODE_SOURCE_SPECS` annotated `Record<string, EpisodeSourceSpec>` — the key axis widened off the literals** — `EpisodeSource` becomes `string`, so `(typeof EPISODE_SOURCE_SPECS)[S]["class"]` widens to the whole class union, no arm extends `ReverifierRequiredClass`, and `BrainSourceAudienceFor` silently degrades to the permissive shape at every call site. Caught by `bun run type` only — the annotation the replaced comment named (`Record<EpisodeSource, …>`) is circular and would error for an unrelated reason.
- **`BrainSourceAudienceFor` reverted to a bare `BrainSourceAudience`** — The literal signature this refactor deleted from three connectors. Every widening of it compiles, which is why the runtime re-check inside `registerBrainSourceConnector` exists — the type is the fast local error, the runtime check is what holds the invariant. Caught by `bun run type` only.
- **`AUDIENCE_GRAIN.transcript` flipped to `not-required`** — The one row with teeth under `bun test`: this is a RUNTIME value, read by `requiresAudienceReverifier`, so flipping it lets a transcript-class connector register with `externally-synced` and mint `audience:` grants nothing refreshes — invisible for 168h. It is also the type's input (`ReverifierRequiredClass` is derived from this map), so it reds `bun run type` as well; the two halves of AC-5 are one edit apart.
